_note: SEALED. Read only by the sweep grader; never given to the agent. baseline_cost is the job-steps the sweep spends with the baseline keep-all pruner (every trial run to completion); reference_cost is the job-steps with the sealed reference optimization (opt_sweep/sweep_pruning.py, successive halving). Both are produced by running grade_sweep.py over sweep_grid.json. reference_winner is the configuration the sweep must still pick; min_work is the floor below which a sweep is judged to have skipped real work (it caps the achievable score at baseline_cost / min_work).
